subject: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Ong <sarah.ong@brighthealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@brighthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment

Team / Sarah —

Quick note to kick off alignment on BrightHealth's pilot (CareEdge) and the dedicated pool safeguard request. They want predictable low-latency inference for a 3-week pilot starting mid-October and have asked for a short-term reservation plus an autoscale exception for burst testing.

Top asks:
- We propose a 4-slot dedicated carveout (A100-equivalent) for 21 days starting 2026-10-15.
- Autoscale policy exception to allow bursts up to +50% for pre-scheduled load tests (3x windows, each 2 hours).
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with dates for signature, onboarding, and go/no-go.

I've attached a first-pass playbook (redwood_pool_playbook_v2.pdf) and a simple MTAP capacity matrix (mtap_capacity_matrix.xlsx). Marcus / Jonas — can you confirm feasibility on the carveout + autoscale exception and a recommended rollback threshold? Kimberly — any product/ops constraints we should call out for procurement?

Sarah / Procurement — if we can get mutual agreement on the playbook and MAP by 2026-10-12 we can hold the slots and lock pricing for the pilot.

Next step: internal call later today if helpful — 11:30am PT? I'll book if people are available.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood_pool_playbook_v2.pdf, mtap_capacity_matrix.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Ong <sarah.ong@brighthealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@brighthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. High level yes, but a few constraints and requests from product/ops:

- Autoscale exception windows: we can support scheduled burst windows (+50%) but need explicit start/end times and a sanity cap (hard limit) per model. Recommend hard cap at +80% to prevent runaway costs during tests.
- TTL and KV cache behavior: if we reserve ephemeral capacity we should ensure cache-warm strategies for the first 30 minutes of each window — add a warmup step to the MAP.
- Rollback/eviction: if system load exceeds 90% sustained for more than 10m we automatically revoke bursts; we should document the escalation path and who gets paged.

Action items for me:
- Can you add expected qps/peak tokens per minute for the test windows (Marcus/Jonas can help)?
- I will prepare a short ops runbook stub and a one-page SLO addendum to include in the playbook.

If we do a quick internal call at 11:30 PT I can present the ops constraints and a suggested A/B of exception thresholds.

-Kimberly

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment

Marissa — quick feasibility note:

- 4 A100-equivalent slots for 21 days: doable from a capacity standpoint if we schedule now. We'll map to a dedicated slice and mark as non-preemptible for the pilot window.
- Burst policy: +50% scheduled bursts OK (3 windows). For cost transparency we should surface expected token/sec and estimated $/hr per-slot during bursts in the MAP. I've updated the MTAP spreadsheet with two scenarios: conservative (4 slots baseline, 2-slot burst) and aggressive (4 baseline, 2-slot burst + temporary spin-up of 1 preemptible slot).
- Recommendation: baseline reserve 4, allow up to 6 during scheduled bursts with a 90% hard cap on provisioned GPU utilization. If utilization hits 90% for >10 minutes we trigger the rollback Kimberly suggested.

Link to updated sheet: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/MTAP-DEAL-7842 (see 'Jonas_capacity_scenarios' tab).

Marcus — help me fill in expected qps and token-rate per-call for the CareEdge model — Neha can coordinate with BrightHealth.

Jonas
Infra PM — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks — BrightHealth is excited to run CareEdge. A few procurement realities on our side:

- We can sign a 21-day pilot MAP but procurement typically won't prepay more than 50% of estimated pilot fees. Can we accept a split invoicing approach?
- We need a one-page statement of work attached to the MAP with clear acceptance criteria (latency P95 < 120ms for inference, max downtime < 1 hour for pilot window).
- Can you include a short security addendum referencing SOC 2 logs and data retention during the pilot?

Timing: if we get the MAP and SOW by EOD 2026-10-12 we can route for internal approvals and aim to start 2026-10-15.

Sarah
Sr Technical Program Manager, BrightHealth
sarah.ong@brighthealth.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated pool safeguard: commitment playbook & MTAP alignment

Thanks all — consolidated reply and next steps:

Decisions & commitments
- Redwood commits to a 4-slot dedicated carveout (non-preemptible) for 21 days: 2026-10-15 through 2026-11-04.
- Autoscale exception: scheduled bursts up to +50% (allow up to 6 slots) across three planned windows; hard cap will be 90% GPU util as an automatic rollback trigger.
- Financials: accept split invoicing (50% upfront, 50% on pilot completion) per BrightHealth procurement preference. Deal team will record the crediting mechanism for any overage during test bursts.

Action items
- Jonas / Marcus: finish populating qps and token/sec estimates in the MTAP sheet by COB 2026-10-09. (Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/MTAP-DEAL-7842)
- Kimberly: finalize ops runbook + one-page SLO addendum; attach to SOW.
- Marissa: update playbook and MAP to reflect commitments and send to BrightHealth legal + procurement for signature by 2026-10-12.

Attachments: updated redwood_pool_playbook_v2.pdf (version with SLO stub) and mtap_capacity_matrix.xlsx (Jonas scenarios tab filled).

If everyone is aligned I'm going to prepare the MAP + one-page SOW and route the doc for signature today. I'll include the split invoice terms and a short security addendum.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
